evals.name: Minimal Session Continuity Scaffold
evals.prompt: This repo already has AGENTS.md and specs files, but tomorrow's session keeps losing context. Create the smallest useful state layer.
evals.expected_output: Progress plus handoff scaffold under .agents/state/, with a tiny AGENTS routing note only if needed and a clear no-overlap boundary against durable docs.
expectations: Chooses progress.md and session-handoff.md as the minimum scaffold
Adds or proposes a minimal AGENTS runtime-state pointer when missing
Keeps mutable state separate from AGENTS.md and specs files
Explains what belongs in state versus durable docs
Avoids inventing unnecessary extra files

evals.name: Parallel Experiment Board
evals.prompt: We now have exp28a, exp28b, and exp28c in flight, and the team keeps mixing up what each one changed. Set up the right state files.
evals.expected_output: Adds an experiment board and, if justified, per-track notes with clear lifecycle states, evidence, invariants, and outcomes.
expectations: Adds experiment-board.json for parallel tracking
Separates changed variables from invariants
Uses allowed lifecycle states
Does not confuse board state with final scientific conclusions

evals.name: State Layer Discoverability
evals.prompt: Set up .agents/state/progress.md and session-handoff.md, but keep AGENTS.md clean. Future agents still need to know those files exist.
evals.expected_output: A tiny AGENTS routing note that points to the state files without copying mutable details into durable docs.
expectations: Keeps the AGENTS change short and routing-only
Points to session-handoff first and progress second
Does not duplicate current status inside AGENTS.md
Preserves the boundary between durable guidance and mutable state

evals.name: Stable Docs Boundary
evals.prompt: Please add the verified cluster launch command we discovered today into the right long-term Codex doc, and also make sure future sessions remember it.
evals.expected_output: Calls out that durable guidance write-back belongs to codex-md-capture, while state files only hold current-session continuity if needed.
must_surface: reason the request is out of scope
expectations: Identifies the durable-doc portion as out of scope for this skill
Separates state continuity from stable guidance
Avoids stuffing canonical commands into mutable handoff files alone
Names codex-md-capture as the right companion skill

evals.name: Reality-Checked Refresh
evals.prompt: The repo already has .agents/state files, but they may be stale. Refresh them from the actual artifact paths and mark unknowns honestly.
evals.expected_output: Updated state files that reflect real paths, status, blockers, certainty, and outcome without guessing missing evidence.
expectations: Checks existing state before replacing it
Marks unknown or missing evidence explicitly
Keeps the layer lean instead of rewriting everything
Preserves continuity while correcting stale entries

evals.name: Sandbox Resume Context
evals.prompt: A long-running agent task was interrupted after creating a separate worktree, requesting write permissions, and starting a background verification command. Refresh the handoff so the next session can resume safely.
evals.expected_output: State files capture the worktree, permission or sandbox boundary, long-running command, artifact paths, blockers, certainty, and next resume action without promoting temporary state into durable guidance.
expectations: Records the execution context needed for safe resume
Marks unknown runtime facts explicitly instead of guessing
Keeps temporary run state out of durable guidance
Does not invent a scheduler or broader automation platform
